# Vendored schematic style analyzer

`circuit-json-schematic-placement-analysis.browser.js` is the browser bundle loaded by tscircuit's schematic viewer for **Run Style Analysis**. It is kept here so local review and CI apply the same analysis without depending on a changing network response.

- Retrieved: 2026-10-06
